player.title: Buffs and Nerfs choose better

title: Trample only works on attack
notes: R1750000: a unit's Trample applies only to the hits of its own attack, its hit on the defender and its Cleave's, so a defender's strike back and the damage a unit's text deals never trample, and an attack on an ally a Redirect re-aimed still tramples into its own hero; a Spell that prints Trample tramples as before (revises R63 and R176). A game with a Trample unit meets it, so the classifier reads it as a rule every game meets.

player.title: Trample only works on attack
changes: Trample sends the excess damage to a hero only when the unit with it is the one attacking.
A unit with Trample that is attacked strikes back for its full attack and no longer damages the hero of the unit that attacked it.

title: Update how multiple activates work
notes: R1751000: each Activate on a card tracks its uses and cooldown on its own (card.memory activations now {turn, count, abilities}), so a fused Activate no longer shares the kept card's count (amends R1087); clicking Activate on a card with several Activates opens a Discover-style ability picker. 18 cards that fuse, copy or refund activations play differently, found by classify.

player.title: Fused Activates work separately
changes: Each Activate on a card with several now has its own uses and cooldown, so using one leaves the others ready the same turn.
Clicking Activate on a card with several Activates opens a panel to choose which one to use.

player.title: Immune to tribal tag based hate is an ability
changes: Blue-Eyes White Felinor keeps its immunity to tribal tag based hate, now printed as an ability line instead of a keyword: no bold, no icon on the board.

title: Prestige can be played only with a card to De-Radiant
notes: R1851000-R1851003: Meditative #53 Prestige is offered, and its play accepted, only while a Radiant card it could De-Radiant exists, where R1103 let either face be played and fizzle. The base face's declared target is required (R703): a Radiant Unit or face-up backrow card on either side or a Radiant card in your hand, never a face-down Trap. The Radiant face declares no target, so it takes the engine's new play gate (Script.play_allowed, play_choices::play_allowed), one check for legal_actions, the reducer's refusal ("<name> cannot be played without something to act on") and the view's playReason, read off the face the play resolves (R214); its gate asks for a Radiant card the opponent controls on the field that its player can see, so a face-down one does not open it (R440), though the Cry still clears it. A cast, an Echo repeat and a random cast never ask the gate (R70) and a set Spell's Reveal waits for it (R783006); a fusion holds every ingredient's gate and a copier its copied face's (R1851002). A Trade is no play, so Prestige is still Traded with nothing to clear. The script v0.4.9 ran is kept for replays (KEPT_SCRIPTS, R767000).

player.title: Prestige needs a card to De-Radiant
changes: Prestige can be played only with a card to De-Radiant: a Radiant card on the field or in your hand, or for its Radiant face a Radiant enemy card on the field.
A face-down card does not count, since you cannot see whether it is Radiant.
Prestige can still be Traded with nothing to De-Radiant, and a Prestige that is cast still resolves.

changes: Showdown is Tradable.
